title: Generated 47 million voxels of destructable cheese with AI
author: Donkeytonk
selftext:
Testing MCP integration with our microvoxel engine, so I got Claude to try generating dense volumtetric micro voxel cheese.  
  
Material exists through the entire object, not just the surface like with polygons. Here the cheese is destroyed, carved up etc at an atomic level. In this demo, players shoot through cheese with shotguns. At the end of the round you try and guess what's hiding inside it. 

My workflow with Claude went like this: 

* Claude wrote the Lua scripts and pushed them live via the mcp
* The cheese and hidden objects are generated in code (here with primitives)
* Claude tested its own work with real browser players and screenshots.
* I playtested, sent feedback and screenshots, and and iterated with Claude in an afternoon

I was trying to think of some interesting gameplay concepts with this tech and I remembered one of my favortie levels in Donkey Kong Bonanza where you smash through burger cheese. So I thought why not mice with shotguns shooting up cheese swiss style?

In another demo I managed to get Claude to generate entire monsters with flesh, organs that can be shot off bones. Someone else on Reddit suggested a game where you start inside a whales stomach and shoot your way out. Someone on twitter suggested a Geodude game where you smash rocks for treasure. Let me know if you have any gameplay ideas!

Anyway this is just a showcase test so the game is free. If you hook up Claude to the engine through an MCP, that's free too: [https://play.virtualmatter.ai/play/z4tgGG2AGUgpGBYSlrVkj](https://play.virtualmatter.ai/play/z4tgGG2AGUgpGBYSlrVkj)
